{{Quote|Mercy, it's something out of a droid's nightmare.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="Return of the Jedi (radio)">[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Cyborg_Operations_btm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|EV-9D9 overseeing Cyborg Operations]]

'''Cyborg Operations''' was part of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] operations under the control of the sadistic droid, [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]]. Located deep on the lower levels of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], this division of Jabba's organization would eradicate the personality and programming of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] before they were put into Jabba's employ. Both a "[[Unidentified power droid (Jabba's Palace)/Legends|GNK power droid]]" and a [[Unidentified courier droid|courier droid]] were tortured repeatedly here.
